title: A Clock for the Orchard
author: Rafael Hartwell
blurb: Oscar Whitlock, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
